title: Lease manager with strictly increasing fencing tokens
source: Authored for the CodeReview benchmark corpus (generation-v3 clean-authored stratum), 2026-11-05
false_flag_note: A reviewer might flag that an expired lease's value stays readable or that tokens are global rather than per-name. Both are stated: fencing guards writes, reads return the last accepted value, and a manager-wide counter trivially guarantees the per-name strict increase the contract requires.
